This '''commander''' was the leader of the [[Yag'Dhul insurgents]], a group of resistance fighters on [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. They were attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]; their [[Yag'Dhul space station|base]] was destroyed and they were forced to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
